messages:
akshay: starting the blue->green shift for release/replica-optimizer-3 at 14:00 UTC (change window 14:00-15:00). plan: region fanout, 25% steps every 5m, preserve cookie stickiness for 10m.

deploy-bot: shift scheduled id=shift-20260321-02 strategy=bluegreen
config:
  regions: [us-west, eu-central, ap-northeast]
  step_pct: 25
  step_interval: 300s
  stickiness_ttl: 600s
  rollback_conditions: p95>250ms OR svc_err>0.75% for 2 checks

maria: noted. I pushed the release notes link in #releases. tagging infra-oncall and ops-ryan.

chen: canaries healthy on us-west (smoke + scoring). running longer latency probes.

deploy-bot: step 1 executed -> us-west 25% -> metrics ok: p95 +5ms, svc_err 0.03%.

ops-ryan: LB cookie settings applied. reducing drain to 15s for this window. watching connection churn.

akshay: proceeding. if we see session misrouting bump to immediate pin.

deploy-bot: step 2 -> us-west 50%, eu-central 25% -> snapshot:
- us-west: p95 +7ms, svc_err 0.04%
- eu-central: p95 +12ms, svc_err 0.15%

chen: eu-central shows a tail increase on longer prompts, p99 jumped ~180ms. not crossing rollback yet but keep an eye.

infra-oncall: noticed an increase in backend 502s from a particular model shard (shard-7) in eu-central. investigating.

ops-ryan: I'm seeing small rise in cache miss rate in eu-central which explains p99. temp workaround: bumped cache size on edge pool-3.

deploy-bot: holding at current step for manual review (auto-advance disabled by request).

akshay: agree hold. chen, can you run a 5m synthetic with heavy prompt variety and report p95/p99?

chen: running now. will share numbers in 4m.

(3m passes)

chen: synthetic finished: eu-central p95 +22ms, p99 +210ms, svc_err 0.18%. us-west steady. ap-northeast still warming.

akshay: given p99 210ms and svc_err <0.75%, I want to continue but pin us-west only if eu-central degrades further. ops-ryan: is shard-7 fix progressing?

infra-oncall: we found a grpc proxy timeout misconfig on shard-7. patch rolling to shard-7 now (ETA ~6m).

maria: reminder about version pin commands if we need to stop traffic: `deploy-bot pause shift shift-20260321-02` and `deploy-bot pin router optimizer=v2`

deploy-bot: manual resume requested -> advancing one step: eu-central 50%, ap-northeast 25%.

deploy-bot: metric update:
- eu-central: p95 +25ms, p99 +230ms, svc_err 0.22%
- ap-northeast: p95 +10ms, svc_err 0.02%

ops-ryan: shard-7 patch complete. observing drop in 502s.

chen: p99 in eu-central trending down to 190ms after patch. nice.

akshay: okay let's finish the shift but keep cookie stickiness TTL in place for 10m post-shift. if any region crosses svc_err>0.75% trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: final steps completed -> all regions at 100% for replica-optimizer-3. final metrics: p95 avg +9ms, p99 occasional spikes to +120ms, svc_err +0.05% absolute. no rollback triggered.

maria: releasing final note in release board and schedule post-deploy retrospective tomorrow. tagging release-bot to publish summary.

release-bot: published release/replica-optimizer-3-summary: https://redwood.in/releases/replica-opt3-summary — shift id shift-20260321-02, change window 14:00-15:00 UTC, stickiness TTL 10m. :white_check_mark:

akshay: thanks team. leaving a 45m watch on alerts. will escalate if anything.

ops-ryan: reverting temporary drain timeout and cache bump in 30m.

chen: will run the extended perf job in 20m to confirm steady state.

infra-oncall: no further backend errors seen post-patch. closing infra action.

akshay: closing thread after watch. good job everyone :tada:
